title: Bar Payuli
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He removed forbidden fats and sinews from meat in Shmuel's time. As related in Chullin 96a, he was standing before Mar Shmuel, trimming a thigh; he became frightened and the knife fell from his hand, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: אטמא means thigh. The task is removing forbidden fats and sinews, and the knife falls after he is frightened.
Chullin 96a names Bar Payolei and describes trimming a thigh, followed by fright and the falling knife. Hyman’s abbreviated narrative is retained without adding the longer legal discussion.
